description: This file defines the EndpointProviderV2 class in the AWS SDK for PHP. The class provides endpoint resolution based on rulesets and input parameters, with caching capabilities. It plays a role in resolving service endpoints dynamically at runtime.

classes.name: EndpointProviderV2
classes.description: Provides logic to resolve AWS service endpoints from rulesets and input parameters, with caching support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EndpointProviderV2 with a ruleset and partitions, creating a cache for endpoint lookups.

methods.name: getRuleset
methods.description: Returns the associated ruleset object used for endpoint evaluation.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves and returns the endpoint based on input parameters, using cache when possible, or throws if resolution fails.

methods.name: hashInputParameters
methods.description: Creates a hash of input parameters to use as cache key.
